76900.meaning1: having what intention? with what purpose?
76900.commentary: (THa) kim'adhippāyā'ti kīdis'ādhippāyā kīdis'ajjhāsayā, kiṃ saṃkiles'ajjhāsayā, udāhu vodān'ajjhāsayā'ti attho.

examples.text: kiṃchandā kim'adhippāyā, kim'ākappā bhavissare, anāgatamhi kālamhi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

76901.meaning1: with what behaviour? having what conduct?

examples.text: kiṃchandā kim'adhippāyā, kim'ākappā bhavissare, anāgatamhi kālamhi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

76902.commentary: (THa) paṇḍarasagotto'ti paṇḍarassa nāma isino vaṃse jātattā tena samānagotto.
76902.notes: Proabaly refers to the practice of wearing white, or perhaps smearning the body with ashes. See Edgerton pāṇḍarabhikṣu.

examples.text: suṇohi vacanaṃ mayhaṃ, isipaṇḍarasavhaya, sakkaccaṃ upadhārehi, ācikkhissāmy'anāgataṃ.
pāsādike bahū disvā, bhāvitatte susaṃvute, isi paṇḍarasagotto, apucchi phussasavhayaṃ.

76903.meaning1: zealously desiring; ambitious; anxiously striving; (comm) jealous
76903.construction:
ud + su + ka + ī
ussuka + ī
76903.notes: (MW) restless, uneasy, unquiet, anxious; fr. su, 'well', with ud in the sense of 'apart', and affix ka

examples.text: kodhanā upanāhī ca, makkhī thambhī saṭhā bahū, ussukī nānāvādā ca, bhavissanti anāgate.

76904.meaning1: knowing the shore; (only) touching the surface
76904.commentary: (THa) aññātamānino dhamme, gambhīre tīragocarā'ti gambhīre durobhāse saddhamme aññāte eva ñāto'ti, diṭṭho'ti evaṃ mānino, tato eva tassa orabhāge pavattitāya orimatīragocarā.

examples.text: aññātamānino dhamme, gambhīre tīragocarā, lahukā agaru dhamme, aññam'aññam'agāravā.

76905.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of yathāttha
76905.commentary: (THa) voharantā yath'ātthato'ti atth'ānurūpaṃ, aviparīt'atthaṃ dhammaṃ dhammo'ti, adhammaṃ adhammo'ti, vinayaṃ vinayo'ti avinayaṃ avinayo'ti evaṃ dīpentā.

examples.text: guṇavanto'pi saṅghamhi, voharantā yath'ātthato, dubbalā te bhavissanti, hirīmanā anatthikā.

76906.meaning1: wrapped in blue robes; clothed in blue cloth
76906.commentary: (THa) nīlacīvarapārutā'ti akappiyarajanarattena nīlavaṇṇena cīvarena pārutā, tādisaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsetvā c'eva pārupitvā ca vicaraṇakā.

examples.text: uddhatā ca bhavissanti, nīlacīvarapārutā, kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī, carissanty'ariyā viya.

76907.construction:
vi + cara + aṇa + ka
vicaraṇa + ka

examples.text: telasaṇṭhehi kesehi, capalā añjan'akkhikā, rathiyāya gamissanti, dantavaṇṇikapārutā.

76910.meaning1: styled with oil; gelled in place

examples.text: telasaṇṭhehi kesehi, capalā añjan'akkhikā, rathiyāya gamissanti, dantavaṇṇikapārutā.
telasaṇṭhehi kesehi, capalā añjan'akkhikā, rathiyāya gamissanti, dantavaṇṇikapārutā.
telasaṇṭhehi kesehi, capalā añjan'akkhikā, rathiyāya gamissanti, dantavaṇṇikapārutā.
telasaṇṭhehi kesehi, capalā añjan'akkhikā, rathiyāya gamissanti, dantavaṇṇikapārutā.

76915.meaning1: completely infatuated (with); thoroughly enamoured (with); totally enthralled (by)
76915.commentary: (THa) odātesu samucchitā gedhaṃ āpannā. dantavaṇṇapārupanassa hi idaṃ kāraṇavacanaṃ. te hi setakaṃ sambhāventā sabbena sabbaṃ setake gahite liṅgapariccāgo eva siyā'ti dantavaṇṇaṃ pārupanti.

examples.text: ajegucchaṃ vimuttehi, surattaṃ arahaddhajaṃ, jigucchissanti kāsāvaṃ, odāte susamucchitā.

76916.meaning1: being troubled (with); having difficulty (with); (comm) growing weary (of)
76916.commentary: (THa) kicchantā'ti, kilamantā, vanapatthesu vasituṃ kicchantā kilantacittā'ti attho.

examples.text: lābhakāmā bhavissanti, kusītā hīnavīriyā, kicchantā vanapatthāni, gām'antesu vasissare.

76917.meaning1: taking pleasure in wrong livelihood; delighting in a wrong mode of living

examples.text: ye ye lābhaṃ labhissanti, micchājīvaratā sadā, te t'eva anusikkhantā, bhajissanti asaṃyatā.

76918.commentary: (THa) milakkhurajanaṃ rattan'ti kālakacchakarajanena rattaṃ. samāsapadañ'h'etaṃ, gāthāsukh'atthaṃ sānunāsikaniddeso.

examples.text: milakkhurajanaṃ rattaṃ, garahantā sakaṃ dhajaṃ, titthiyānaṃ dhajaṃ keci, dhārissanty'avadātakaṃ.

76919.meaning1: (gram) nasalized; with a nasal consonant; with a niggahīta
76919.construction:
sa + anu + nāsā + ika
sānunāsā + ika

examples.text: pilakkharajanaṃ rattaṃ, garahantā sakaṃ dhajaṃ, titthiyānaṃ dhajaṃ keci, dhārissanty'avadātakaṃ.

76921.commentary: (THa) mahāghorā'ti sarīrajīvitesu nirapekkhatāya bhimmā garutarā paṭisaṅkhā aññehi acintiyā cintāmattena pavattetuṃ asakkuṇeyyā chaddantamahānāgassa āsi, ahosi.

examples.text: abhibhūtassa dukkhena, sallaviddhassa ruppato, paṭisaṅkhā mahāghorā, nāgass'āsi acintiyā.

76922.meaning1: will wear; will put on; will clothe oneself (in)

examples.text: anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ, yo vatthaṃ paridhassati, apeto damasaccena, na so kāsāvam'arahati.

76923.meaning1: impure; without bright qualities; (comm) (or) without endeavour

examples.text: vipannasīlo dummedho, pākaṭo kāmakāriyo, vibbhantacitto nissukko, na so kāsāvam'arahati.
yo ca sīlena sampanno, vītarāgo samāhito, odātamanasaṅkappo, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.

76925.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of anāgataddhāna

examples.text: evaṃ anāgat'addhānaṃ, paṭipatti bhavissati, bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ'ca, patte kālamhi pacchime.

76926.meaning1: as per conduct; according to behaviour
76926.commentary: (THa) yathācārī'ti yathā kāy'ādīhi saṃyato, saṃvuto hutvā carati viharati, yathācaraṇasīlo'ti vā yathācārī, sīlasampanno'ti attho.

examples.text: yathācārī yathāsato satīmā, yatasaṅkappajjhāyi appamatto, ajjhattarato samāhit'atto, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

76927.meaning1: as per mindfulness; according to attentiveness; (comm) as per peace
76927.commentary: (THa) yathāsato'ti yathāsanto. gāthāsukh'atthañ'hi anunāsikalopaṃ katvā niddeso kato, santo viya, ariyehi nibbiseso'ti attho.

examples.text: yathācārī yathāsato satīmā, yatasaṅkappajjhāyi appamatto, ajjhattarato samāhit'atto, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

76928.meaning1: (gram) elision of the nasal consonant; denasalization

76929.meaning1: path of not forming various opinions; way of nonproliferation

examples.text: yo ca papañcaṃ hitvāna, nippapañcapathe rato, ārādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.

76931.meaning1: speaking in moderation; who is measured in speech

examples.text: upasanto uparato, mattabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto.

76932.commentary: (THa) tassā satthu varavimuttiyā aggaphalavimuttiyā te mahāsamudd'ādayo upamāya upamābhāvena na yujjanti kalabhāgam'pi na upentī'ti attho.

examples.text: mahāsamuddo pathavī, pabbato anilo'pi ca, upamāya na yujjanti, satthu varavimuttiyā.

76933.commentary: (THa) paṭhav'āp'aggisamāno'ti iṭṭh'ādiārammaṇasannipāte nibbikāratāya pathaviyā āpena agginā ca sadisavuttiko.

examples.text: cakk'ānuvattako thero, mahāñāṇī samāhito, pathav'āp'aggisamāno, na rajjati na dussati.

76934.meaning1: perfection of wisdom; ultimate state of understanding

examples.text: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.

76935.meaning1: as if stupid; like a dull-witted person
76935.commentary: (THa) ajaḷo jaḷasamāno'ti sāvakesu paññāya ukkaṃsagatattā sabbathā'pi ajaḷo samāno param'appicchatāya attānaṃ ajānantaṃ viya katvā, dassanena jaḷasadiso mandasarikkho

examples.text: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.

76936.meaning1: who takes delight in (others') misfortune; who has schadenfreude
76936.commentary: (THa) vibhūtanandinā'ti sattānaṃ vibhūtaṃ vibhavanaṃ vināsaṃ icchantena, vibhūtaṃ vā visuṃ bhāvo bhedo, taṃ nandanena

examples.text: pisuṇena ca kodhanena ca, maccharinā ca vibhūtanandinā, sakhitaṃ na kareyya paṇḍito, pāpo kāpurisena saṅgamo.

76937.commentary: (THa) vibhūtanandinā'ti sattānaṃ vibhūtaṃ vibhavanaṃ vināsaṃ icchantena, vibhūtaṃ vā visuṃ bhāvo bhedo, taṃ nandanena

examples.text: pisuṇena ca kodhanena ca, maccharinā ca vibhūtanandinā, sakhitaṃ na kareyya paṇḍito, pāpo kāpurisena saṅgamo.
khīṇ'āsavo visaññutto, saṅg'ātīto sunibbuto, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jātimaraṇapāragū.

76939.meaning1: who has gone beyond birth and death

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavo visaññutto, saṅg'ātīto sunibbuto, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jātimaraṇapāragū.

76940.meaning1: carrying a lamp; holding a light

examples.text: bahussuto appassutaṃ, yo suten'ātimaññati, andho padīpadhāro'va, tath'eva paṭibhāti maṃ.

76941.synonym: dhara, dhāraya, dhārī, bhara, hattha, hāra, hārī

examples.text: bahussuto appassutaṃ, yo suten'ātimaññati, andho padīpadhāro'va, tath'eva paṭibhāti maṃ.

76942.meaning1: knowing the Dhamma; understanding the teaching
76942.commentary: (THa) tasmā asaṅkhataṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha dukkh'ādīsu pariññ'ādivisiṭṭhakiccatāya dhammaviññāṇasaṅkhātaṃ dhammañāṇaṃ ākaṅkhanto tathāvidhaṃ vuttappakāraṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ bhajetha, seveyya payirupāseyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ, sappaññaṃ buddhasāvakaṃ, dhammaviññāṇam'ākaṅkhaṃ, taṃ bhajetha tathāvidhaṃ.

76943.commentary: (THa) kāyamaccheragaruno'ti kāyadaḷhībahulassa kāye mamattassa ācariy'upajjhāyānam'pi kāyena kattabbaṃ kiñci akatvā vicarantassa.

examples.text: kāyamaccheragaruno, hiyyamāne anuṭṭhahe, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇaphāsutā.

76944.meaning1: giving weight to; giving importance to
76944.commentary: (THa) kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno'ti duṭṭhullaṃ asubhayogyatā, kāyassa duṭṭhullaṃ kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ, kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ garu sambhāvitaṃ yassa so kāyaduṭṭhullagaru, anissaraṇappañño hutvā kāyaposanappasuto kāyadaḷhibahulo'ti attho, tassa kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno.

examples.text: kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno, hiyyamānamhi jīvite, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti.

76945.grammar: pr, from na uṭṭhahati, neg, intrans
76945.meaning1: does not get up; does not arouse oneself
76945.construction:
na > an + ud + ṭhaha + ti
na + uṭṭhahati

examples.text: kāyamaccheragaruno, hiyyamāne anuṭṭhahe, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇaphāsutā.

76946.meaning1: comfort in asceticism; pleasantness in monasticism
76946.commentary: (THa) kuto samaṇaphāsutā'ti evarūpassa puggalassa sāmaññavasena kuto sukhavihāro, phāsuvihāro na tassa vijjatī'ti attho.

examples.text: kāyamaccheragaruno, hiyyamāne anuṭṭhahe, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇaphāsutā.

76947.meaning1: is evident; is visible; is clear
76947.commentary: (THa) na pakkhanti disā sabbā'ti puratthim'ādi-bhedā sabbā disā na pakkhayanti, disāmūḷho'ti attho.

examples.text: na pakkhanti disā sabbā, dhammā na paṭibhanti maṃ, gate kalyāṇamittamhi, andhakāraṃ'va khāyati.

76948.meaning1: is evident; is visible; is clear; is distinct

examples.text: abbhatītasahāyassa, atītagatasatthuno, n'atthi etādisaṃ mittaṃ, yathā kāyagatā sati.

76950.commentary: (THa) atītagatasatthuno'ti āyasmato atīto hutvā nibbānagatasatthukassa, satthari parinibbute'ti attho.

examples.text: abbhatītasahāyassa, atītagatasatthuno, n'atthi etādisaṃ mittaṃ, yathā kāyagatā sati.

76951.meaning1: settled down for the rainy season
76951.commentary: (THa) vassupeto'ti vassakāle kulāvakaṃ upeto pakkhī viya. vās'upeto'ti'pi pāḷi, vāsaṃ upagato'ti attho.

examples.text: ye purāṇā atītā te, navehi na sameti me, sv'ajja eko'va jhāyāmi, vass'upeto'va pakkhimā.

76952.commentary: (PVa) dadantānaṃ vā karontānaṃ vā samudāyabhūtaṃ bahuṃ janaṃ puññakammato vārayissaṃ nivāresiṃ.

examples.text: dassanāya abhikkante, nānāverajjake bahū, mā vārayittha sotāro, passantu samayo mamaṃ.
assaddho maccharī c'āsiṃ, kadariyo paribhāsako, dadantānaṃ karontānaṃ, vārayissaṃ bahu jane.

76953.meaning1: being a trainee; being a learner
76953.commentary: (THa) sekhabhūtassa me sato'ti sekhabhūmiyaṃ sot'āpattiphale ṭhitassa me sato.

examples.text: paṇṇavīsativassāni, sekhabhūtassa me sato, na kāmasaññā uppajji, passa dhammasudhammataṃ.

76954.meaning1: perception of ill-will; conception of aversion

examples.text: paṇṇavīsativassāni, sekhabhūtassa me sato, na dosasaññā uppajji, passa dhammasudhammataṃ.

76955.meaning1: remembering the good teaching; bearing the true doctrine in mind

examples.text: gatimanto satimanto, dhitimanto ca yo isi, saddhammadhārako thero, ānando ratanākaro.

76956.meaning1: supporting many people; looking after various people

examples.text: na gaṇena purakkhato care, vimano hoti samādhi dullabho, nānājanasaṅgaho dukho, iti disvāna gaṇaṃ na rocaye.
karerimālāvitatā, bhūmibhāgā manoramā, kuñjar'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
karerimālāvitatā, bhūmibhāgā manoramā, kuñjar'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
nīl'abbhavaṇṇā rucirā, vārisītā sucin'dharā, indagopakasañchannā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

76960.meaning1: like a dark blue summit of a stormcloud

examples.text: nīl'abbhakūṭasadisā, kūṭ'āgāravar'ūpamā, vāraṇ'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

76961.meaning1: like an excellent building with a peaked roof

examples.text: nīl'abbhakūṭasadisā, kūṭ'āgāravar'ūpamā, vāraṇ'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
nīl'abbhakūṭasadisā, kūṭ'āgāravar'ūpamā, vāraṇ'ābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
pārevatā ravihaṃsā, cakkavākā nadīcarā, vāraṇ'ābhirudā rammā, ubho kāl'ūpakūjino.

76963.commentary: (VVa) vāraṇo'ti hatthī. so hi paccatthikavāraṇato gamanaparikkilesavāraṇato ca vāraṇo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: nīl'abbhakūṭasadisā, kūṭ'āgāravar'ūpamā, vāraṇa-abhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
abhivuṭṭhā rammatalā, nagā isibhi sevitā, abbhunnaditā sikhīhi, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

76965.meaning1: wanting to meditate; wishing to practice jhāna

examples.text: alaṃ jhāyitu'kāmassa, pahit'attassa me sato, alaṃ me atthakāmassa, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

76966.meaning1: wanting to apply effort; (or) wishing to meditate

examples.text: alaṃ me phāsukāmassa, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno, alaṃ me yogakāmassa, pahit'attassa tādino.

76967.meaning1: covered with clouds; hidden by clouds
76967.commentary: (THa) gaganā'v'abbha chāditā'ti tato eva saradassa gaganaabbhā viya kāḷameghasañchāditā, nīlavaṇṇā'ti attho.

examples.text: umāpupphena samānā, gaganā'v'abbhachāditā, nānādijagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

76968.meaning1: filled with different flocks of birds
76968.meaningLit: sprinkled with various twice born groups

examples.text: anākiṇṇā gahaṭṭhehi, migasaṅghanisevitā, nānādijagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
anākiṇṇā gahaṭṭhehi, migasaṅghanisevitā, nānādijagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

76971.meaning1: mere oral recitation; mere verbal repetition

examples.text: oṭṭhappahatamattena, attānam'pi na passati, patthaddhagīvo carati, ahaṃ seyyo'ti maññati.

76972.commentary: (THa) patthaddhagīvo caratī'ti ahaṃ bahussuto, satimā, paññavā, na mayā sadiso añño atthī'ti mānatthaddho hutvā garuṭṭhāniyānam'pi apacitiṃ adassento ayosalākaṃ gilitvā ṭhito viya thaddhagīvo carati.

examples.text: oṭṭhappahatamattena, attānam'pi na passati, patthaddhagīvo carati, ahaṃ seyyo'ti maññati.

76973.grammar: adj, compar of na siri, neg (+instr or +abl)
76973.commentary: (THa) aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ, bālo maññati attānan'ti ayaṃ aseyyo hīno samāno aññena seyyena uttamena samānaṃ sadisaṃ katvā attānaṃ bālo mandabuddhi bālabhāveneva maññatī'ti.

examples.text: aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ, bālo maññati attānaṃ, na taṃ viññū pasaṃsanti, patthaddhamānasaṃ naraṃ.

76974.commentary: (THa) aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ, bālo maññati attānan'ti ayaṃ aseyyo hīno samāno aññena seyyena uttamena samānaṃ sadisaṃ katvā attānaṃ bālo mandabuddhi bālabhāveneva maññatī'ti.

examples.text: aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ, bālo maññati attānaṃ, na taṃ viññū pasaṃsanti, patthaddhamānasaṃ naraṃ.

76975.commentary: (THa) na taṃ viññū pasaṃsantī'ti taṃ tādisaṃ bālaṃ paggahitacittatāya patthaddhamānasaṃ thambhitattaṃ naraṃ viññū paṇḍitā na pasaṃsanti, añña'd'atthu garahantiyeva.

examples.text: aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ, bālo maññati attānaṃ, na taṃ viññū pasaṃsanti, patthaddhamānasaṃ naraṃ.

76976.commentary: (THa) patthaddho ussitaddhajo thambhavasena garūnam'pi nipaccakārassa akaraṇato bhusaṃ thaddho anonamanathaddhajāto ussitamānaddhajo.

examples.text: n'āttano samakaṃ kañci, atirekaṃ ca maññisaṃ, atimānahato bālo, patthaddho ussitaddhajo.

76978.commentary: (ADha) nicchayavasena ārammaṇe pavattituṃ asamatthatāya thambhitattaṃ, cittassa thaddhabhāvo'ti attho. (MNt) thambhitattaṃ rūpassā'ti avinibbhogarūpassa thambhitabhāvo.

examples.text: tattha katamā bāhirā vāyodhātu? yaṃ bāhiraṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa bahiddhā anupādinnaṃ.
ete sambahulā devā, iddhimanto yasassino, dasadevasahassāni, sabbe te brahmakāyikā.

76980.meaning1: gathered like marksmen; assembled like snipers
76980.commentary: (THa) vālavedhisamāgatā'ti ye mayaṃ vālavedhidhanuggahasadisā atisukhumam'pi visayaṃ paṭivijjhituṃ samatthā āgatā upaparikkhantā n'ābhijānāma, gambhīro vata buddhānaṃ visayo'ti attho.

examples.text: accheraṃ vata buddhānaṃ, gambhīro gocaro sako, ye mayaṃ n'ābhijānāma, vālavedhisamāgatā.
taṃ tathā devakāyehi, pūjitaṃ pūjan'ārahaṃ, sāriputtaṃ tadā disvā, kappinassa sitaṃ ahu.
yāvatā buddhakhettamhi, ṭhapayitvā mahāmuniṃ, dhutaguṇe visiṭṭhohaṃ, sadiso me na vijjati.
yāvatā buddhakhettamhi, ṭhapayitvā mahāmuniṃ, dhutaguṇe visiṭṭhohaṃ, sadiso me na vijjati.

76984.meaning1: inclining towards renunciation; bent towards giving up sensual pleasure
76984.commentary: (SNa) nekkhammaninnan'ti navalok'uttaradhammaninnaṃ. (THa) nekkhammaninno abhinikkhammaninno tato eva tibhav'ābhinissaṭo bhavattayato vinissaṭo visaṃyutto.

examples.text: na cīvare na sayane, bhojane n'upalimpati, gotamo anappameyyo, muḷālapupphaṃ vimalaṃ'va, ambunā nekkhammaninno, tibhav'ābhinissaṭo.

76985.meaning1: escaped from the three realms of existence; released from the three realms of being
76985.commentary: (THa) nekkhammaninno abhinikkhammaninno tato eva tibhav'ābhinissaṭo bhavattayato vinissaṭo visaṃyutto.

examples.text: na cīvare na sayane, bhojane n'upalimpati, gotamo anappameyyo, muḷālapupphaṃ vimalaṃ'va, ambunā nekkhammaninno, tibhav'ābhinissaṭo.

76986.meaning1: with attending mindfully as one's neck
76986.commentary: (THa) tattha guṇarāsito uttam'aṅgabhūtāya paññāya adhiṭṭhānabhāvato satipaṭṭhānaṃ gīvā etassā'ti satipaṭṭhānagīvo

examples.text: satipaṭṭhānagīvo so, saddhāhattho mahāmuni, paññāsīso mahāñāṇī, sadā carati nibbuto'ti.
satipaṭṭhānagīvo so, saddhāhattho mahāmuni, paññāsīso mahāñāṇī, sadā carati nibbuto'ti.

76988.meaning1: gone to a woodland; entered the forest
76988.commentary: (THa) pavanagato vihassan'ti… mahāvanagato kadā nu kho ahaṃ viharissāmi.

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhinnapaṭan'dharo muni, kāsāvavattho amamo nirāso, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca tath'eva mohaṃ, hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ.

76989.meaning1: producing fear; giving rise to danger

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

76990.meaning1: twisting around in various ways; with multiple entwinings
76990.commentary: (THa) taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattanin'ti bahuvidhañ'ca ārammaṇaṃ bhavam'eva vā anuvattati santanotī'ti bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, taṇhāsaṅkhātalataṃ.

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

76991.meaning1: seeking the goal; for the purpose of welfare

examples.text: kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
kadā nu nāgo'va asaṅgacārī, padālaye kāmaguṇesu chandaṃ, nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ nimittaṃ, jhāne yuto taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

76993.meaning1: sound of great Inda; noise of Mahinda; i.e. thunder

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

76994.meaning1: seeking renewed existence; looking for rebirth
76994.commentary: (THa) aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā'ti yattha yesu vatthukāmesu kilesakāmesu ca sitā paṭibaddhā te andhaputhujjanā tena kāmarāgena punabbhav'esino ek'anten'eva dukkham'icchanti.

examples.text: kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham'icchanti punabbhav'esino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, iti'ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

76996.meaning1: elements of awakening and the development of mental stability; the factors of enlightenment and cultivation of meditative composure

examples.text: bhāvehi jhānāni ca indriyāni ca, balāni bojjh'aṅgasamādhibhāvanā, tisso ca vijjā phusa buddhasāsane, iti'ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

76997.meaning1: plunged into the wearing away of all suffering; immersed in the extinction of stress

examples.text: bhāvehi maggaṃ amatassa pattiyā, niyyānikaṃ sabbadukhakkhay'ogadhaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, iti'ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

76998.commentary: (THa) abhisāpam'āgato'ti piṇḍolo vicarati pattapāṇī'ti ariyehi kātabbaṃ abhisāpaṃ upagato. vuttañ'h'etaṃ, abhisāpo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, lokasmiṃ piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇī'ti (saṃ. ni. 3.80).

examples.text: muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, iti'ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
ropetva rukkhāni yathā phal'esī, mūle taruṃ chettu tam'eva icchasi, tath'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ karosi, yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi.
